BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE SANJAY DWIVEDI  ON THE 21 st OF JUNE, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 24703 of 2023 BETWEEN:-
KAMAL S/O BALCHAND, AGED ABOUT 21 YEARS,
OCCUPATION: PRIVATE WORK R/O NANDRI TEHSIL JIRAPUR DISTRICT RAJGARH (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .....APPLICANT (BY SHRI GYANPRAKASH TRIPATHI - ADVOCATE)
AND THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH P.S.
LORDGANJ DISTRICT JABALPUR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .....RESPONDENT (BY SHRI L.A.S. BAGHEL - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:

ORDER This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail relating to FIR No.525/2022 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Lordganj, District Jabalpur, for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 370, 376(2n), 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The applicant's first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 01.12.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.55367 of 2022 granting liberty to file a new after recording of statement of prosecutrix before the trial Court.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in jail since 09.09.2022.

He submits that after withdrawal of applicant's first bail application, statement of prosecutrix got recorded wherein she has not made any allegation against the present applicant for commission of rape with her.
He submits that in view of the above, it is clear that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the alleged offence.
Therefore, he prays that looking to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the applicant's custody period, he may be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned Government Advocate has opposed the prayer of bail.

Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, perusal of case diary and the statement of prosecutrix wherein she has not alleged against the applicant for committing rape with her, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance on the dates given by it.
It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
